JOIN THE HIGHEST EARNING AFFILIATE PROGRAM

Welcome to one of the most rewarding affiliate experiences in the industry. At Energy Rocks, we’re more than a brand — we’re a movement built around innovation, wellness, and irresistible flavor. As a valued affiliate, you’ll have the opportunity to promote our unique product line, connect with an energized audience, and earn generous commissions along the way.

BRAND INTRODUCTION:

Energyrocks was created by a competitive athlete and visionary entrepreneur who formulated a proprietary delicious energy and focus popping candy free from messy mixes and caffeine crashes. Energyrocks delivers a delicious burst of taste and energy that works like a boss.

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION:

Elevate your energy game with two exotic flavors of Cherry Berry and Pine Apple Mango, the ultimate tropical treat to your daily boost featuring 15 sachets of popping candy supplement delivering a refreshing and energizing experience in every pop, anytime, anywhere. No water. No mixing. No bulky bottles. Just open a sachet, pop it in your mouth, and get ready to rock. 

WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT?

✅ Instant Energy, Zero Crash

✅ Delicious Flavors: Cherry Berry & Pineapple

✅ Low Sugar (only 4g sugar)

✅ No Aftertaste, No Junk

✅ Pocket-Sized Convenience

✅ Made in the USA with high-quality standards

✅ Save time. 🔟x your productivity

✅ Keeps you sharp, focused, and boosted for hours

✅ Convenient & Travel-Friendly: Ideal for athletes, busy professionals, drivers, and anyone on the move

✅ Clean Ingredients: No need to stress about hidden chemicals or artificial junk

✅ Fun to Use: It’s like candy... that powers your day

YOUR MISSION AS AN AFFILIATE:

You’re not just selling a product — you’re part of a movement to reshape how people power their lives. Your content, stories, and promotions will help your audience ditch the crash and fuel up smarter.

Whether your followers are fitness freaks, office warriors, late-night coders, dancers, or just caffeine-weary humans — Energy Rocks is made to fit their lifestyle.

You’ll be provided with ready-to-use promotional assets, including:

  • 9 customized design categories

  • Earn 15-30% flexible commission on every order

  • Coupon code placements

  • Easy-edit templates

  • Suggested descriptions , social captions, Hashtags

  • Social media tips & tagging strategy

COMMISSION STRUCTURE

Earn a 15-30% flexible commission on each referred order when a customer makes a purchase through your affiliate link or use your coupon code. 

Earnings Potential — How Much Can You Earn? 

💡  With consistent effort, The more you refer, the higher your tier, the bigger your commission — plus rewards, gift packs, and exclusive bonuses along the way. You’re not just earning, you’re leveling up your passive income every 10 orders

Auto Tier Commission Structure — Earn More, Unlock More

With every referral, you climb the ranks and unlock serious perks: from free samples and custom branded gear to your own Coupon Code Boost for higher conversions. Plus, enjoy surprise cash bonuses between $20–$50, and at Tier 5, claim a one-time $100 bonus and VIP status.

“This program doesn't hope you’ll succeed — it’s designed to make sure you do ”

Sign Up Now and unlock your way to success with our Highest Paid Affiliate Program
term_and_condition:
Welcome to the Energy Rocks Affiliate Program


We’re thrilled to have you here! By joining our Affiliate Program, you become a vital part of our mission to energize lives with clean, delicious, and effective hydration. This document outlines the terms of our partnership, the tools you’ll get access to, and how you’ll earn commissions.

By signing up, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please refrain from registering or participating in our program.



1. Registration Approval

We review every application to ensure a great brand fit. While we’d love to welcome everyone, we reserve the right to approve or reject any application at our sole discretion. If your application is denied and you'd like a second look, reach out to us at energyrocksstore@gmail.com



2. Affiliate Links & Coupons

Upon approval, you'll gain instant access to your unique referral link and can generate additional links for specific products or collections directly from your dashboard.

We may also assign you a custom affiliate coupon code — use it to drive more conversions! If a customer uses both your link and your coupon, rest assured: only one commission will apply.

You’re free to promote us through your channels — whether online (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, blogs, YouTube) or offline (events, printed media, word of mouth). Creativity is welcome!



3. Commissions & Payments

Earn 15-30% commission on every successful sale you refer — calculated on the order value, excluding taxes and shipping.

Commissions are displayed in real-time on your dashboard. Once you’ve set up your preferred payment method (e.g., PayPal, Bank Transfer), you’ll receive payouts as scheduled in our Affiliate Guide.

Note: We do not issue commissions for orders that are canceled, refunded, or result in chargebacks.



4. Full Suite of Promotion Tools

As an affiliate, you’ll unlock a powerful set of marketing tools, including:

  • Trackable links & codes

  • Banners, product images & creatives

  • Email swipe files

  • Embeddable widgets

  • Real-time analytics dashboard


Find all of these in your Marketing Tools tab — ready to copy, download, and share.



5. Network & Team Commissions (if enabled)

Grow your own affiliate team! If the network feature is activated, you can invite others to join through your referral network link. Every time they make a sale, you earn a network commission, too.

It’s team-building meets passive income.



6. Cookie Tracking

We use cookies to track referrals. Our standard cookie window is 30 days, which means if someone clicks your link and purchases within that timeframe, you earn commission — even if they come back later.

Note: If cookies are disabled or cleared, tracking may be lost.



7. Removal from Program

Want to step away from the program? No hard feelings. Just email us at energyrocksstore@gmail.com and we’ll take care of the rest.



Let’s Rock This Together

We’re excited to have you on board and can’t wait to see what you achieve. You’ll always have access to these terms via your dashboard. If you have questions, just email us anytime at energyrocksstore@gmail.com


Ready to make waves (and money)?
Welcome to the Energy Rocks movement.
